label: CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS
description: MikroTik CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS - cloud core router: 1x 1G RJ45, 12x 10G SFP+ cages and 2x 25G SFP28 cages, quad-core ARM AL32400.
notes: MikroTik specification table: section Ethernet prints "10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 1", section Fiber prints "SFP+ ports: 12" and "Number of 25G SFP28 ports: 2", section Peripherals prints "Serial console port: RJ45". The prose agrees: "12 x 10G SFP+ and 2 x 25G SFP28 ports". The single copper jack is a 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 socket and the twelve cages are SFP+, so both declare their connector; the two SFP28 cages are 25G cages and nothing in the vendor material states a slower module in them, so they declare no speedCaps rather than an invented fallback. No PoE in either direction. Sources: https://mikrotik.com/product/ccr2004_1g_12s_2xs and https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/ccr2004-1g-12s-plus-2xs/
